entries.details: Received PCR call DD No. 42-B at 19:35 hrs. Reached Flat 302, Rishi Apartments. Met complainant Vikram Malhotra, recorded his complaint. Inspected scene with forensic team. Registered FIR No. 534/2024 under BNS 305/329/324. Collected CCTV DVR from building main gate camera. Photo documentation by HC Ramesh Kumar. Recorded statements of witnesses Sunita Kapoor and Mahesh Kumar. Conducted spot panchnama. Seized broken padlock, iron rod, and fingerprints.
entries.exhibits_collected: Broken padlock, iron rod, fingerprints, footprint cast, CCTV DVR, photographs

entries.details: HC Ramesh Kumar analyzed CCTV footage. Male in black t-shirt identified as Ravi Shankar Yadav, former security guard of Rishi Apartments, dismissed in September 2024. Motorcycle registration DL4SBK7890 captured on MCD street camera. Verified from RTO: motorcycle belongs to Ravi Shankar Yadav. Verified from RWA records: dismissed security guard's address is Jhuggi No. 45, Rehgar Pura. Background check revealed prior conviction for house theft in 2019 (Neb Sarai PS). Obtained prior FIR copy and conviction details. Team dispatched for surveillance.

Police team led by me reached Rehgar Pura at 08:00 hrs. Conducted local inquiry. Confirmed presence of Ravi Shankar Yadav at residence. Arrested accused at 11:00 hrs from his house in presence of witnesses Mahesh Kumar and Ranjit Singh. Personal search conducted - recovered mobile phone, wallet, keys, iron rod, black bag. Accused medically examined at Safdarjung Hospital (MLC/SJH/2024/9234). Recorded memorandum statement under Section 27 Indian Evidence Act. Recovered stolen ornaments - 4 gold bangles, 3 gold rings, 6 silver coins, cash ₹85,000 from iron trunk under bed at accused's instance. Recovered motorcycle DL4SBK7890 and second iron rod. Recorded detailed voluntary statement of accused admitting the crime. Produced accused before Ld. MM, sent to judicial custody.

Packed and sealed all exhibits. Dispatched to FSL Rohini through Constable Mohan Singh with RC No. 456/2024: iron rods (crime scene + recovered), broken padlock, fingerprint lift sheets, footprint cast, CCTV DVR, black bag. Also sent reference fingerprint cards of accused, victim, and witness Sunita Kapoor for elimination. Verified CCTV footage from 3 sources synchronized. Obtained RTO records of motorcycle. Recorded supplementary statement of complainant confirming value of stolen items and providing purchase receipts.

Inquired into whether accused had any accomplices. Interviewed RWA staff, other security guards, and neighbors. All confirm accused acted alone. Mobile CDR of accused shows no calls in the window 14:15-14:55, indicating no coordination with others. GPS location data from mobile confirms single-person movement from Rehgar Pura to Karol Bagh and back. No evidence of any accomplice.

Visited jewellers in Sadar Bazar based on accused's statement about selling some ornaments. Identified one jeweller - Rajesh Soni of Soni Jewellers - who purchased 1 gold necklace and pair of diamond earrings from accused on 21-11-2024 for ₹4,20,000. Jeweller produced the items which were seized. Jeweller's records obtained. Investigation reveals accused disposed of some items before arrest. These items recovered and added to evidence list.

Recovered from Soni Jewellers: 1 gold necklace (45g) and pair of diamond earrings matching victim's description. Purchased by jeweller in good faith without knowledge of theft. Recovery memo prepared. Jeweller will be prosecution witness to establish chain. Total recovery now stands at ₹14,75,000 approximately out of ₹18,45,000 stolen.

Received final FSL Report No. FSL/DL/2024/BIO/6721. Findings conclusive: fingerprints match accused at 3 locations, tool marks on padlock match iron rod, footprint matches accused's footwear, CCTV identification confirmed. Report made part of case file. All exhibits returned.

All evidence collected, statements recorded, forensic reports received. Prima facie case established under BNS 305, 329, 324. Prepared final investigation report and draft chargesheet. Compiled annexures list of 22 documents. Submitted to ACP Karol Bagh for approval. Recommended chargesheet before Ld. MM.

case_diary.case_diary_certification: Certified that this case diary contains a true and complete account of investigation conducted in case FIR No. 534/2024 PS Karol Bagh.
case_diary.supervisory_remarks: Investigation thorough. Chargesheet approved. - ACP Karol Bagh, 28-12-2024
